description: This Dart file defines the FavoritesScreen widget and accompanying _EmptyState widget for a Flutter mobile app. It displays a list of favorited recipes or an empty state when no favorites are available.

classes.name: FavoritesScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a list of favorite recipes or an empty state message.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a message and icon indicating no saved recipes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for FavoritesScreen and _EmptyState.
